link-scan-bot: Auto-scan detected 404s on docs shortlink '/kb/runtime/legacy-snippet' across 5 pages. Severity: low. Suggested action: rehost snippet or update shortlink. Scan id: 2026-03-18-77

link-scan-bot: Affected pages: /kb/runtime/guide-quickstart, /kb/runtime/benchmarks, /kb/runtime/deploy-cheatsheet, /kb/runtime/faq, /kb/runtime/ops-runbook. Full report: https://internal.scans/reports/2026-03-18-77

eve.k: Thanks — pinging the docs folks. I can take a quick pass tomorrow morning. Which pages need the minimal edits vs rehosting? @sam.c @kai.w

sam.c: I broke that shortlink when I moved snippets to S3 last year, apologies. The object is s3://redwood-docs/snippets/legacy/legacy-snippet.tar.gz. I can rehost it back under the CDN path or remove references. Prefer to rehost so examples keep working.

kai.w: heads-up: some pages reference the shortlink inside fenced code blocks, so we need source MD updates and rendered link fixes. I can do two pages (guide-quickstart + benchmarks) if someone takes the runbook/deploy-cheatsheet.

eve.k: I'll take benchmarks + FAQ. @sam.c can you take runbook + deploy-cheatsheet? Also please add `custodian: sam.c` to the frontmatter of the snippets index if you're going to own it — helps future scans.

sam.c: Will do. Plan: upload object to CDN path `/static/snippets/legacy/legacy-snippet.tar.gz`, update references in MD, add frontmatter `custodian: sam.c`. I'll open a draft PR by EOD.

leo.t: If you rehost to S3+CDN, make sure the CDN path uses `/static/snippets/legacy/legacy-snippet.tar.gz` exactly and set a short TTL during the first day to avoid stale 403s. I can invalidate the CDN after PR merges.

maria.p: Quick QA ask — can we add a tiny CI check that greps for `/kb/runtime/legacy-snippet` references so future moves fail CI until a custodian/frontmatter is present? Even a non-blocking lint for one week would help.

kai.w: Good idea. I can add a lint rule: CI warns on `/kb/runtime/legacy-snippet` unless a `custodian:` frontmatter is present in the file. Low-risk, easy revert.

eve.k: Plan summary: sam uploads + opens PR, eve & kai split MD edits (benchmarks/faq + guide-quickstart/benchmarks?), leo handles CDN invalidation, maria adds CI lint, sam adds `custodian:` frontmatter. Tagging triage: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/DOCS-1120

sam.c: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4589 (draft). Assigning reviewers: @eve.k @kai.w. Will mark ready after upload.

link-scan-bot: Noted. Will re-run sweep in 24h and post delta report. :white_check_mark:
